description: This file defines a custom media route provider for Android's media routing framework. It manages different media routes, handles control requests such as play, pause, seek, volume adjustments, and session management, and provides descriptions of the media routes. The class demonstrates creating a media route provider with multiple route configurations and embedded control logic.

classes.name: SampleMediaRouteProvider
classes.description: A custom media route provider for managing different media routes with control handling and session management.

classes.name: SampleRouteController
classes.description: Inner class that manages media control requests, session lifecycle, and media playback for a specific route.

methods.name: publishRoutes
methods.description: Creates and publishes media route descriptors representing available routes with various configuration parameters.

methods.name: onCreateRouteController
methods.description: Returns a new route controller instance for the specified route ID.
